findings.title: `to_cents` truncates instead of rounding, so every third quote is one cent short
evidence: src/pricer/money.py:14 — `return int(amount * 100)` drops the fraction; `to_cents(1.005)` -> 100, expected 101

counterfactual (scratch copy, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, __pycache__ swept, import verified inside the scratch): replacing the line with Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP -> 6 passed, 0 failed; original restored -> 1 failed again

root_cause.mechanism: `money.to_cents` converts through `int()`, which truncates toward zero; `invoice.line_total` and `report.monthly_total` call it per line, so the error accumulates once per line rather than once per invoice.
root_cause.origin: b7e1c2a (2026-08-12) `perf: avoid Decimal in the hot path` replaced `Decimal(...).quantize(...)` with the int() form

class.pattern: money converted to cents through int() instead of a half-up rounding
sites: src/pricer/report.py:41 — monthly_total rounds with round(), a second implementation of the same rule
